create_CrystalReconstructionEvaluator: create a CrystalReconstructionEvaluator instance with custom tolerance parameters for crystal structure matching
append_predictions_and_ground_truths: append prediction and ground truth numpy array dictionaries to the CrystalReconstructionEvaluator for batch evaluation
compute_reconstruction_metrics: compute match rate and RMS distance metrics between predicted and ground truth crystal structures
generate_wandb_evaluation_table: generate a wandb.Table with per-sample crystal reconstruction results including 2D visualizations and atom types
